raw_title: LITJAM Hyderabad: Pyaar Aur Yaari Ka Musical Night
blurb: LITJAM Hyderabad: Pyaar & Dosti Jam ❤️🫶 Some people come for the love songs. Some come with their best friends. Some come solo and leave with a whole new bunch of people to sing with. LITJAM: Pyaar & Dosti Jam is an evening celebrating all the people who make life a little more special — your person, your people, your besties, your almosts, and everyone in between. ❤️ Get ready for a high-energy LITJAM packed with your favourite Bollywood love songs, friendship anthems, nostalgic throwbacks, big group singalongs, musical games, fun interactions and plenty of moments to vibe together. Whether you're single, with your partner, or coming with your gang, there's a place for you here. 🎤 Sing your heart out to songs you already know every word to. 🎶 Go from iconic love songs to unforgettable friendship anthems. 🎲 Get involved in fun musical games and challenges. 🫶 Meet new people, reconnect with your favourite ones, and make some new memories. ✨ And, of course, experience the signature LITJAM energy that Hyderabad already knows and loves. Because whether it's Pyaar or Dosti, some feelings are best expressed through music. Hyderabad, let's sing it out together. ❤️🎶

What is the Entrepreneur's Mixer? Hyderabad's startup scene has grown quietly but seriously. There are real founders here building real things. What's still missing is a space where they can sit across from each other without the noise of a large event getting in the way. That's what this is. Entrepreneur's Mixer is a vetted gathering for founders and business builders who are past the idea stage and actually executing. Not a seminar. Not a panel. Just a focused evening with people who are in the same game as you. Sneak Peek: https://youtu.be/lzZRU5t4LJ4 Who This Is For Founders, CXOs, & Directors of product-based companies at the MVP stage or beyond Founders, CXOs, & Directors of service-based businesses with active paying clients Angel Investors and Senior Investment Analysts (From VCs, Family Offices, etc) Industry Veterans (20+ years’ expertise), and Country/Regional Head/Manager (e.g., India Head, Asia Pacific Head, EMEA Head) Only 3 slots are available for Startup Enablers (CA, Legal, Design, Tech) — these are reserved, not guaranteed. Student founders are not eligible. If you don't meet the criteria, venue and payment details will not be shared. ​ See Who Attends : Explore Previous Attendees from our curated mixers. What the Evening Looks Like This is not a seminar. There's no stage, no slides, no one talking at you. 5:15 PM — Introduction Round: Quick, structured introductions so everyone in the room knows who's who within the first 30 minutes. 5:45 PM — Ice Breaker Activity: A simple activity that cuts through the awkwardness and gets real conversations going faster than usual. 6:15 PM onwards — Open Networking: The rest of the evening is yours. Talk to whoever makes sense. Follow up on whatever came up in the room. Small enough that you actually get time with people. Structured enough that you don't waste the first hour figuring out who to talk to. Event Fe: ₹500 It covers your entry, light snack, and access to a private community of 300+ verified founders and decision-makers. More importantly, it — combined with the screening — ensures everyone who shows up has made a conscious, deliberate choice to be there. That changes the quality of every conversation in the room. How to Register: Submit your profile and business details. We review your application Approved? You get the payment link and the exact venue address Not a fit? We'll let you know — no hard feelings Incomplete or delayed responses to our queries will result in cancellation. Notes: The location shared publicly is indicative and meant to give you a general idea of the travel distance and area. Exact venue details are shared only with the approved attendees.
